text:
SY312
Conversation Analysis
0.5 Credit
Hours per week:
Lecture/Discussion: 3
Introduces conversation analysis as a method of identifying actions as they occur in mundane and institutional talk. Starting with the pioneering work of Harvey Sacks, the
course
surveys the cumulative findings of conversation analysis and their utility for the analysis of talk-in-interaction.
Additional Course Information
Prerequisites
SY281
or permission of the department.
Exclusions
SY309C.
